notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34656719/185847050a14d1d9fea2f827ab0d0f28de284859.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34656719/d553a34c1670f596276d06dedccf66075bd09775.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Version 0.2.6[/h1]
_
In this version, we have mainly focused on fixing game-breaking bugs as well as huge performance optimisation to Rendering and Physics. For more details, please visit our in-game release note.
_
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34656719/185847050a14d1d9fea2f827ab0d0f28de284859.png[/img]
_
We have also added a wheel-driven mech to our steam workshop. Yes, a fully working mech that is equipped with 2 miniguns. This shows the capability of this game of crafting different types of vehicles using multiple actuators and weapons.
_
For more details about our mech, please visit [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1702686805]here[/url].

notes.title: Workshop Vehicles
notes.notes:
A new vehicle is uploaded to the Workshop and can be downloaded, played, edited. You can remove bit by bit to see how the vehicle is crafted, if that helps you understand more about the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34656719/2864d971073b3cb596f7285877ae7eb581de2748.jpg[/img]

In order to see the vehicle, either click on vehicle from the browse menu in Steam Workshop page or follow the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1690530473]link[/url].

In order to import the vehicle to the game:
1. Subscribe to the vehicle
2. Go to the file window
3. Click on the Steam Icon
4. Click on Subscribed Vehicles
5. Select the vehicle and click on import

Have fun ;)

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34656719/2864d971073b3cb596f7285877ae7eb581de2748.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34656719/a38c39a0774880c47e9f3a47e2e4f2738aadca22.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Launching Announcement
notes.notes:
[h1]We are finally on our game's launch date![/h1]


The version of the game currently on right now is 0.2.4, meaning this game is still in Beta phrase. 

You can follow our release note and roadmap at the bottom right corner of the game menu.

We have created a detailed tutorial integrated in the game which can be accessible from anywhere, please feel free to post on the forums if you have anything want to ask or bugs report. We will be responding as soon as possible.

Finally, please enjoy the game and have fun.
